title: CMSPC - Custom Max Server Player Count
description: CMSPC - Customize your server’s player limit! Show any max player number in the server list, just like 2b2t.
body:
# CMSPC – Custom Max Server Player Count

 CMSPC lets you control the maximum player number shown in your server list without affecting real gameplay.

# Examples

 Just like the famous 2b2t server, you can give your server a unique, fun, or mysterious vibe.

## Features:

- **Change the max players displayed** in the server list.
- **Simple** setup – plug and play.
- **No extra dependencies** – works on Paper and Spigot.
- **Lightweight** and easy to use.
  
### Use cases:

 Anarchy or creative servers wanting a mysterious or epic vibe.
Hubs/lobby servers showing huge or tiny slots for fun.
Any server looking to stand out in the server list.
